UI is still present: `in-sprint` non-owner items still render `OpenItemRow`, which includes a toggle form (`group.ts.tmpl:80-83`, `page.tsx.tmpl:343-348`). This remains a misleading orphan affordance.

New findings:

- HIGH: Action errors are returned but not surfaced in the panel. `toggleReadinessItemAction` returns `{ ok:false, error }`, but the server-component forms are not wired through `useActionState`, redirect state, thrown errors, or any rendered error slot (`page.tsx.tmpl:132-149`, `actions.ts.tmpl:61-91`). Founder-visible result: denied writes, missing ids, non-owner toggles, and patch failures look like silent no-ops.

- HIGH: Done rows can also expose invalid toggles for non-owner items. `groupReadinessItems` sends every `status === "done"` item to `done` before checking `owner_class` (`group.ts.tmpl:75-77`), and `DoneItemRow` always renders a toggle form. A completed `sprint-work` or `waiver` item becomes “Mark as not done,” but the action rejects it. This is the same orphan-toggle class outside the prior open `in-sprint` path.
